title: Forged Progression
description: Upgrade-based progression datapack for tools and armor instead of crafting.
body:
Forged Progression completely reworks Minecraft’s survival progression by removing direct crafting of higher-tier tools and armor.  
Instead, you must upgrade your existing equipment step by step.

---

## 🔧 Features

- Start with wooden tools  
- Progress by upgrading tools instead of crafting new ones  

### Tool progression:
Wood → Stone → Iron → Diamond  

### Armor progression:
Leather → Chainmail → Iron → Diamond  

(netherite crafting remains vanilla)

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- ✅ Vanilla Minecraft (Datapack)  
- ✅ Multiplayer compatible  
- ⚠️ May conflict with other datapacks that modify recipes  

---

## 📦 Installation

- Download the datapack  
- Place it into your world's `datapacks` folder  
- Run `/reload` or restart the world  

---
